title: Hormuz GKG share leads BASF long 3d
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] GDELT hormuz GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads BASF returns by 3 days (+) as war-period Hormuz spikes were followed by BASF relief rallies (reversal of R2-0034, 0/5 hits short); trade long BAS.DE 3d [gdelt.gkg.hormuz_share -> finance.BAS.DE.log_return] (parent: R2-0034)
message: Long BAS.DE 1d after Hormuz GKG z>1: 5/5 hits, avg +1.84%, excess +1.57%, actionability 9.1 but validity 0 (r=0.09, n=392), only 5 war-period trades - suggestive, not robust

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.hormuz_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long BAS next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
